data.description:
## Context

`scripts/check_server_manifest.py` currently compares only environment variable names. `server.json` publishes `name`, `description`, and `isRequired` for each record, so description drift, requiredness drift, and duplicate records can pass the current gate. `rebar.mcp_server.MCP_ENV_VARS` remains the canonical inventory. The F05 generated ownership catalog remains deferred and is outside this task.

## Plan

- Refactor the checker to normalize complete `name`, `description`, and `isRequired` records from the canonical inventory and `server.json`.
- Reject duplicate names in either inventory before comparison.
- Report missing, extra, and changed records with enough field detail to identify the correction.
- Add focused checker tests for the clean manifest, each changed field, and duplicate detection.
- Preserve the existing CI entry point and MCP authentication contract coverage.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The committed `server.json` passes comparison against normalized canonical records.
- [ ] A description mismatch causes a nonzero checker result and identifies the affected name.
- [ ] An `isRequired` mismatch causes a nonzero checker result and identifies the affected name.
- [ ] A duplicate name in either inventory causes a nonzero checker result.
- [ ] Focused checker and MCP manifest contract tests pass.
- [ ] Lint and type checking pass.
data.title: F14 validate complete MCP manifest environment records
